title: Naturality with shift of the canonical base-change map
statement: Use the boundaries and shift structures fixed by [def-pc-rf-mv-canonical-ses-shifts], but no cover or SES. For any commutative square f,f prime,g,g prime, any a:A to K[n], and any psi:Lg prime star K to K prime, the composite Lg star Rf star(a), the composite source shift, and the shift of base change at K followed by Rf prime star(psi), equals base change at A followed by Rf prime star(Lg prime star(a), the pullback shift and psi[n]) and the target shift. This is the component naturality and shift equation of the pinned base-change transformation of [lem-pc-pinned-base-change-mate-shifts].

proof.text: Obtain the tensor-pullback additivity witnesses from exists_derivedPullbackComposition. Obtain a family of shifts compatible with the pinned left-derived counits. The pinned-derived-adjunction theorem makes this family compatible with exactly the adjunction defining mvCanonicalPullbackShift. Mathlib compatibilityUnit_unique_left identifies the family with our adjunction-mate shifts, since the right-derived shifts are fixed.

Obtain the actual base-change natural transformation commuting with the shifts from exists_pinned_base_change_mate_shifts. Rewrite its shift property using the equalities of shift structures. Apply its naturality at a, its shift equation at K, and the right-derived shift naturality at psi. Reassociate compositions and expand functor map_comp to obtain the formula.
